intro: High passes, blue lakes and Buddhist monasteries. That is Leh-Ladakh in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Leh-Ladakh
paragraphs: Leh-Ladakh (Ladakh) is known for its mountain, adventure and roadtrip experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is May to September.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly into Leh, or drive via the Manali–Leh or Srinagar–Leh highways in summer.

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Leh town near the Main Bazaar

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Spend your first 48 hours in Leh resting to acclimatise to the altitude.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Leh-Ladakh?

faq.a: Fly into Leh, or drive via the Manali–Leh or Srinagar–Leh highways in summer.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Leh-Ladakh?
faq.a: Popular choices: Leh town near the Main Bazaar; Changspa for quieter guesthouses; Camps at Pangong and Nubra.
